Amit Regev ok.
Anyway, your terminology is still wrong. If you submitted a partner visa application (online), and received a request to complete some documents, that does not mean the application is closed and you have to resubmit it. The application is open.
I do not know why they refuse to extend his tourist visa, I guess it's because he entered as a tourist without a proper invitation in advance (which is the legal path). Anyway once you complete all the documents he should be granted a B1 visa, not a tourist visa.
